headline: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Rejects Appointment Of Interim Leader
seoTitle: FFI Rejects PSSI Appointment of Interim Chairperson
metaDescription: Federasi Futsal Indonesia chair Michael Sianipar has formally challenged the PSSI's decision to appoint an interim leader as illegal and invalid.
aiSummaryBullets: Federasi Futsal Indonesia maintains Michael Sianipar is the legitimate chair for the 2024-2028 term.
The organization has officially challenged PSSI decree 271/SKEP/XI-2026 as legally invalid.
Leadership changes within the organization must be conducted through an Extraordinary Congress.
aiContextParagraph: The conflict between the Federasi Futsal Indonesia (FFI) and the Football Association of Indonesia (PSSI) intensified following the issuance of a decree on November 12, 2026. This directive designated Vivin Cahyani as the interim leader for the FFI. In response, Michael Sianipar, the current chair of the FFI, declared the appointment an illegal act that lacks a proper legal foundation. Sianipar argues that his leadership remains valid for the 2024-2028 period and asserts that any formal change in the organization's head must follow the established procedure of an Extraordinary Congress (KLB). While the FFI leadership has expressed support for external financial audits regarding non-government budget funds, they continue to contest the authority of the PSSI to unilaterally impose changes to their executive structure, describing the move as a violation of procedural norms.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by three independent news outlets with moderate coverage velocity, indicating ongoing interest in the leadership dispute.
